1.consolidated_definition: med. Enfermera graduada, suplente de un médico. Enfermera especializada cualificada que trabaja sin la supervisión de un médico. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. El Departamento de Estudios Graduados del Decanato de Enfermería te ofrece la oportunidad de obtener especialidades clínicas en Anestesia, Family nurse practitioner y especialidades clínicas en varios escenarios (UPR, Recinto de Ciencias Médicas, consultado 08-01-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medical graduate nurse, substitute for a physician. Qualified specialized nurse who works without the supervision of a physician. Raw anglicism, frequent. The Graduate Studies Department of the College of Nursing offers the opportunity to obtain clinical specialties in Anesthesia, Family Nurse Practitioner, and clinical specialties in various settings (UPR, Medical Sciences Campus, consulted 08-01-08).
